title: Flingo Tier Tagger
description: Client-side Fabric mod that fetches and displays Flingo Tiers rankings next to player names in nametags and the tab list.
body:
# Flingo Tagger

**Flingo Tagger** is a client-side Fabric mod that pulls player tier rankings from the [Flingo Tiers](https://flingotiers.vercel.app) ranking system and displays them directly in Minecraft — next to nametags, in the tab list, and on armor stands/text displays.

Based on [TierTagger](https://github.com/mctiers-dev/TierTagger) by **uku3lig** and **netiyiy** (MPL-2.0). Credit to them for the original architecture.

![Flingo Tier Tagger Showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ee334333b8ee72e84ad30e212bf0ef351497096c_0.webp)

---

## Features

- 🏷️ **Nametag tags** — tier shown above player heads in the world
- 📋 **Tab list tags** — tier shown next to names in the player list
- 🎮 **9 gamemode icons** — Axe, Mace, NetHop, Pot, SMP, Spear, Sword, UHC, Vanilla (custom bitmap font icons)
- ⚙️ **Config screen** — configure via Mod Menu (show icons, tier colors, gamemode preference, highest-tier display mode)
- 🔍 **`/flingo-tagger <player>`** — look up any player's full rankings in chat
- 🔁 **Auto-caching** — rankings are fetched once and cached per session
- 🔔 **Auto update checker** — notified in chat when a new version is available on Modrinth

## How Tiers Work

Flingo Tiers is a Minecraft PvP ranking system covering multiple gamemodes. Rankings use a High Tier / Low Tier system (HT1, LT1, HT2, etc.) with peak tracking. The mod fetches rankings live from the Flingo Tiers backend (Firebase Firestore, public read).

**Supported gamemodes:** Axe · Mace · NetHop · Pot · SMP · Spear · Sword · UHC · Vanilla

You can view the full leaderboard at [Flingo Tiers](https://flingotiers.vercel.app).

## Configuration

Open via **Mod Menu → Flingo Tagger** or press Escape → Mods.

Options include:
- Toggle tier tags and icons on/off
- Set your preferred gamemode display
- Choose between showing your selected gamemode tier, highest tier, or always highest
- Customize tier colors

## Commands

- `/flingo-tagger <username>` — prints that player's full rankings in chat

---

*Client-side only — works on any server.*
